## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- Croatia Control planned a total asset value for other new investments in RP4 of 56.5M€2022. Croatia Control planned no new major investments for RP4.

- According to the reporting tables, Croatia Control underspent -2.6M€2022 (-14.4%) in costs related to investments in 2025. These amounts must be reimbursed to the airspace users through a reduction of future unit rate(s), unless the NSA decides after consultation with the users, that the ANSP must not reimburse a part of the difference according to article 28 of Regulation (EU) 2019/317.

- Croatia Control reported no funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
